name: layered_regime_normalization
description: Retrieve and separate observation artifacts, temporary interventions, and enduring regime changes before forming forecasting assumptions.
applicability: When a historical time series may contain recording anomalies, promotions, pricing interventions, or other conditions that differ from the forecast horizon.
query_strategy: Search the forecast window and relevant preceding history for named mechanisms, start and end boundaries, permanence statements, incentive changes, and explicit planning assumptions; classify each verified claim by mechanism layer and determine whether it affects measurement, behavior, or the future regime.
verification_rule: Accept a normalization claim only when reliable evidence identifies the mechanism, establishes its temporal boundary or permanence, and supports whether it continues into the forecast horizon; preserve exact quotations and provenance when required, and do not infer recurrence or normalization from silence.
